subtask: Final package semantic object inventory + Host/Runtime comparator contract + actual-output honesty boundary

requirements.summary: The final package is re-audited after every Phase 6 projection. FULL_DELIVERY_OBJECT_MANIFEST is derived dynamically from actual canonical business objects and production asset packages rather than a static hand-list.
Stable package-level canonical object IDs and semantic hashes now provide the final identity plane that the detailed source/evidence/assumption/decision lineage closure will bind to next.

verified_behavior: An unknown/new canonical business-object family is automatically included in the final semantic object manifest; a static registry cannot silently omit it.
Removing an object row fails the semantic inventory audit even when the canonical JSON value remains physically present elsewhere in the package.
Host-native versus Runtime parity compares canonical object IDs and semantic hashes, not file layout, Markdown formatting, headings or raw byte identity.
A single Runtime export never fabricates Host-native parity; without an independently materialized Host-native package the final manifest records E2E_PENDING_INSTALLED_HOST_EXPORT.

Provider job materialization/result templates are not actual-output proof. Actual-output status remains E2E_PENDING until real Provider Result, accepted output Review, accepted Local Revision Review, production receipt/output hashes and revised-output lineage hashes are all present.

The final semantic closure executes after REQ-061 canonical parity, REQ-089 routed Human Workspace and activated delivery-family projection, then rebuilds DELIVERY_MANIFEST and the final ZIP from those final bytes.
Earlier FULL materialization audit evidence is preserved as upstream_full_materialization_audit instead of being mistaken for the final Phase 7 audit.

proof.focused_integrated_green: 5/5 passed including final export ordering / ZIP integration

invariants: Final package semantic truth is computed from final bytes after all projections, never from an earlier materialization snapshot.
Semantic object parity is different from installed-host E2E proof; source comparator implementation cannot be promoted to actual Host-native parity without a second package.
Planning/provider-job existence is never promoted to actual-output QA.
This subtask does not yet close the complete REQ-088 lineage chain or every Phase 7 package-continuity requirement.
Fresh K01 FULL and Provider actual-output proof remain later-phase evidence.
